payfoe.pregunta: Do you want to move your tokens to PayFoe? How many?

payfoe.hecho: Done: {n} tokens in PayFoe. Use them wisely. Or not.
payfoe.nada: No new tokens to move to PayFoe.

traspaso.hecho: Done: {n} items in the tournament bag.
